comments.comment: As Pro-Life as I am please do not bad mouth someone who just died because their angry ex-girlfriend with no proof said something for her 15 minutes of fame.
It’s time to just take responsibility for your own actions and just repent to the Lord. Yes, sometimes some people act in ignorance, but once you know, repent. That’s all.
I applaud this woman for telling her story, many suffer in silence
When I was 16 and found out I was pregnant my ex tried to coerce me and I said absolutely not. We need to start taking responsibility for our own choices and stop putting the blame on others. 🤷🏼‍♀️
Prayers for them. I pray that they will align their hearts to God. That will be how they can heal and grow.
